title: Kagamine Len — New Troupe Member!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, I think I want to try coming up with a show like KAITO and the others do, but this time I'll make it on my own!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The only problem is, I'm not sure where to start.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I should probably decide what kind of things I want in the show first. What sounds like it'd be fun?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO's shows are usually a story with singing and dancing. I just need an idea that the audience will enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm... This is harder than I thought.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's the most important thing for a show? Maybe I should start with the script? Or maybe choosing parts? Oh, costumes are really important too.

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line:
Len! You look like you're working hard.
Let us know if there's anything we can do to help!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I will, thanks!
Actually, there was something I wanted to ask you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm trying to figure out everything I need to make a good show. Is there anything you can think of other than the script and costumes?

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line: Hm... Have you thought about stage props?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, stage props!
I completely forgot about that.

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line: There's also stage lighting, any mechanical props you might need... Oh, and music too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hrng...
This is going to take even more prep work than I thought...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I think I'm getting a good overall picture, though.
Let me give it some more thought.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks for the suggestions!

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line: Sure! Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Backgrounds, lighting, production, music...
Then there's the script, costumes, and casting... So much to do...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Making a show sure isn't easy.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: For the audience, the show goes by before you realize it, but the time it takes to prepare could be a hundred times as long as that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wonder if I can do something this tough on my own...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Probably not...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Do you think you can push through to the end even when things get tough?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, I nearly forgot!
I promised I'd see things through to the end no matter what!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I really don't think I can do this on my own. What am I going to do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Creating performances is a lot of hard work.
They aren't something you can do on your own.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I want you to promise you'll remember that great shows rely on everyone working together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You can't make great shows on your own...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh!
This must be what KAITO meant when he said that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I can't take everything on myself.
Alright! I should find Miku and KAITO and ask them for—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hi ho, Len☆
Working hard?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You seem to be struggling with something.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Miku?! KAITO?!
What are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We heard from the stuffed animals that you were working hard on a show, so we came to check on you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How's it coming?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Well, I don't think I can do this on my own.
I was just going to find you two and ask for your help!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
We'd love to help!
Do you have an idea of what kind of show you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm just not really sure where to start...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
In that case, let's get everyone here!
If we all work together, we'll be done in no time!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
KAITO, look! We finished another costume!
What do you think?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It looks great.
Can I get you to start on the main character's costume next?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure! We'll get right on it!

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line:
The stage props are finished!
How does this look?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wow! It's just like I imagined!
Do you think you could lighten the sky just a bit?

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line: I'll see what we can do!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I wasn't getting anywhere trying to do this on my own. Now that everyone's helping, though, things are going so fast.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (It's way more fun coming up with ideas as a group than it was struggling to find ideas on my own, too!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So this is what it means to make a show together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, KAITO. You told me before that you can't make a great show by yourself.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I remember. That's one of the first things I told you when you joined the troupe.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think I finally understand what you meant!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm glad to hear that.
I always believed you'd realize it sooner or later.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. I have everyone here to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright! Let's all make this show a huge success together!
